WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    trans.account_id,
    district.A3 as region,
    SUM(trans.amount) as account_region_sum,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM trans
  JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
  JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
  GROUP BY trans.account_id, district.A3
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    SUM(account_region_sum) as region_total
  FROM step1
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
  step1.account_id,
  step1.region,
  step1.account_region_sum,
  step1.record_count,
  CAST(step1.account_region_sum AS REAL) / step2.region_total as ratio
FROM step1
JOIN step2 ON step1.region = step2.region
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
